resources.string: Open Android Auto settings, scroll down and tap “Version” 10 times, then confirm. Without this, there is no “Start head unit server” item.
On HyperOS these settings are not in the normal Settings app. Open them with the button below.

To get video, YouTube and a browser on the head unit (Fermata Auto, ParkedTube, AABrowser), turn on in Android Auto: Settings → ⋮ → Developer settings → Unknown sources. Without it, Android Auto will not show apps installed outside Google Play.
Turn on the accessibility service “%1$s”. It starts the head unit server by itself when you plug in the USB cable. The service sees only Android Auto windows.

If the item is grayed out: Settings → Apps → Headswap → ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”. Without the service you must start the server by hand before every trip: Android Auto → ⋮ → “Start head unit server”.
Headswap shows its status in the notification shade, and the system keeps the bridge running while the screen is off.
HyperOS kills background apps. Remove the battery limit, or the bridge may disconnect while the screen is off.
Xiaomi: Settings → Apps → Headswap → turn on “Autostart”, then set battery saver to “No restrictions”.
Needed for “Hey Google” and voice input when the car microphone is not available. Headswap then takes your voice from the phone microphone.
Calls in Android Auto always go through Bluetooth. Pair your phone with the head unit once, as a phone or a headset. Music and navigation go through the USB cable.
Google Maps and other map apps in Android Auto need location access. Otherwise the car screen shows “location access required”.
Turn on location and allow it for map apps.
Connect the USB cable to the head unit with the phone unlocked. When Android asks “Open Headswap when this USB accessory is connected?”, check “Use by default for this USB accessory” and tap “OK”.
If the head unit shows a “启动CarLife” screen, tap that button. The phone must be unlocked when you plug it in, or the head unit shows “Unlock your phone”.
Everything is ready for the trip
Tap an item to open its step.
Experienced users can skip this step and set everything up by hand. You can change the car later in Settings → My car.
